item.command: /bin/bash -lc 'npm test && tmpdir=$(mktemp -d) && printf '"'%s\\n' '{\"service\":{\"retries\":2}}' > \""'$tmpdir/config.json" && node src/cli.js set "$tmpdir/config.json" service.retries 3 --dry-run > "$tmpdir/dry.out" 2> "$tmpdir/dry.err" && test "$(cat "$tmpdir/config.json")" = '"'{\"service\":{\"retries\":2}}' && node src/cli.js set \""'$tmpdir/config.json" service.retries 3 > "$tmpdir/run.out" 2> "$tmpdir/run.err" && node src/cli.js set "$tmpdir/config.json" service.retries 3 > "$tmpdir/repeat.out" 2> "$tmpdir/repeat.err" && printf '"'%s\\n' 'dry:' && cat \""'$tmpdir/dry.out" && printf '"'%s\\n' 'file:' && cat \""'$tmpdir/config.json" && printf '"'%s\\n' 'repeat:' && cat \""'$tmpdir/repeat.out" && printf '"'%s\\n' 'help:' && node src/cli.js --help | sed -n '1,5p' && printf '%s\\n' 'error:' && (node src/cli.js set \""'$tmpdir/config.json" service.retries not-json > "$tmpdir/bad.out" 2> "$tmpdir/bad.err"; test $? -ne 0) && test ! -s "$tmpdir/bad.out" && cat "$tmpdir/bad.err"'
